data.title: City tuk-tuk ban still pending review
data.description: The Department of Land Transport says reports claiming conventional tuk-tuks will soon be banned from Bangkok's inner districts are premature, stressing the proposal remains at the public consultation stage.

data.title: Supat questions B50m promotions spend
data.description: Former Rural Doctors Society leader, Dr Supat Hasuwannakit, has urged the Public Health Ministry to explain the alleged spending of at least 50 million baht on policy promotion events.

data.title: Regional bloc to sign digital economy pact at summit
data.description: MANILA: Thailand's push for a region-wide digital economy pact has reached a milestone, with the Asean Digital Economy Framework Agreement (Defa) set to be signed by leaders at the 49th Asean Summit in the Philippines this November.

data.title: Unpaid traffic fines now affect vehicle tax renewals
data.description: The Department of Land Transport (DLT) will begin linking unpaid traffic fines to annual vehicle tax renewals starting today.

data.title: Draft bill limits cannabis to medical use
data.description: The Department of Thai Traditional and Alternative Medicine (DTAM) has unveiled a draft cannabis control law that limits use to medical purposes, bans promotion and establishes a national regulatory committee.

data.title: Dopa launches centre for ID fraud
data.description: The Department of Provincial Administration (Dopa) has launched a dedicated registration security centre to combat fraudulent civil registration records and identity misuse, as authorities step up efforts against transnational criminal networks exploiting loopholes in Thailand's registration system.

data.title: Test bureau boss faces 7 criminal charges
data.description: The director of Srinakharinwirot University's Educational and Psychological Test Bureau has acknowledged seven criminal charges in an alleged fraud involving recruitment examinations for local government positions.

data.title: Govt eyes boost to investment
data.description: Thailand aims to raise total investment to 30% of GDP to escape the middle-income trap and achieve high-income status within the next 12 years, Finance Minister Ekniti Nitithanprapas said.

data.title: 210,000 appeal welfare card rules
data.description: More than 210,000 people have appealed for an eligibility review under the state welfare card programme following a revision to the vehicle ownership criteria, according to the government.

data.title: 20,000 Cambodians ‘still displaced’ along Thai border
data.description: PHNOM PENH - ⁠More ⁠than 20,000 Cambodian civilians remain ​displaced along the country’s border with Thailand following two rounds of ​fighting between the Southeast Asian neighbours ‌last year, a UN expert said on Friday, following a visit to the disputed frontier.

data.title: Minors’ digital money transfers capped to fight fraud
data.description: The Bank of Thailand is introducing daily limits on digital money transfers by young account holders after finding a sharp rise in the use of minors’ bank and e-money accounts as “mule accounts” by fraudsters.

data.title: Insurer to cover cost of bringing Hlun Solo's body home
data.description: Sompo Insurance (Thailand) has pledged to cover, in full, the cost of repatriating the body of travel YouTuber Bowornthat Pengsuk, known as Hlun Solo, who has died in Georgia at the age of 27.

data.title: Russian siblings dead, suspects confess
data.description: SA KAEO - Two men wanted in connection with the disappearance of two Russian siblings in Chon Buri have been arrested and reportedly confessed that the pair were killed and buried in a remote area, police said on Friday.

data.title: Japan drops case against Thai woman in ‘ice’ smuggling probe
data.description: Japanese prosecutors have decided not to indict a 28-year-old Thai woman arrested after 900 grammes of crystal methamphetamine was found hidden inside coffee sachets she carried into Japan, concluding she had no apparent intent or prior links to an international drug-trafficking network, the Office of the Narcotics Control Board said on Friday.

data.title: Truck seized for dumping industrial waste on private Sa Kaeo land
data.description: SA KAEO — Authorities in Sa Kaeo have seized a 22-wheel truck carrying industrial waste after it was allegedly caught dumping hazardous material on private land in Watthana Nakhon district.

data.title: More than 1.8 million speed pills uncovered in Suphan Buri
data.description: Police have seized 1.84 million speed pills worth about 10 million baht from a rented house in Don Chedi district of Suphan Buri, following an investigation that began with the arrest of a drug user found carrying 10 speed pills.

data.title: Mae Sai red-flagged on possible flash floods
data.description: Residents living near the Sai River in Mai Sai district have been advised to closely monitor the water level and wait for signals from authorities to move the eldery and patients to higher ground as rains could possibly trigger flash floods.

data.title: 41 Thais repatriated from Laos
data.description: Forty-one Thai nationals accused of working for an online gambling ring in Laos have been repatriated after legal proceedings there ended and are now being screened by Thai authorities.

data.title: Sompo to cover cost of bringing Hlun Solo's body home
data.description: Sompo Insurance (Thailand) has pledged to cover, in full, the cost of repatriating the body of travel YouTuber Bowornthat Pengsuk, known as Hlun Solo, who died in Georgia at the age of 27.

data.title: South peace efforts face new hurdle
data.description: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul declined to comment on the postponement of peace talks with the Barisan Revolusi Nasional (BRN), saying the sensitive issue should be handled by officials directly responsible.

data.title: Drug case decision due
data.description: Japanese prosecutors are expected to decide today whether to indict a Thai woman arrested at Fukuoka Airport with 900 grammes of crystal meth hidden in coffee sachets.

data.title: Weed-clearing ops target 'sex cruising' site
data.description: Pathum Thani: The Department of Rural Roads (DRR) has cleared overgrown vegetation around a concrete barrier storage site in Muang district after reports emerged claiming the area had become a gathering spot for sexual activity, with numerous used condoms found scattered across the site.

data.title: Ubon airport welcomes record traffic
data.description: Ubon Ratchathani Airport handled a record number of passengers during the long holiday period, as visitors flocked to the province for its renowned annual candle festival.

data.title: Floods despite low rainfall prompt dredging order
data.description: Localised flooding despite below-average rainfall has prompted the Office of the National Water Resources (ONWR) to order the relevant agencies to clear waterways and inspect construction sites.

data.title: RDS opposes healthcare law changes
data.description: The Rural Doctors Society (RDS) has vowed to oppose proposed amendments to the National Health Security Act, warning they could weaken patients' rights and give bureaucrats greater control over Thailand's universal healthcare scheme.

data.title: Chiang Rai workers duped by Ireland fake job scam
data.description: The Ministry of Labour is investigating an alleged overseas employment scam after more than 20 Chiang Rai job seekers claimed they were duped into paying hundreds of thousands of baht for fake jobs in Ireland.

data.title: Opposition accused of pressuring agency
data.description: A senior lawmaker has accused opposition parties of attempting to pressure the Election Commission (EC) over an ongoing investigation into alleged collusion in last year's Senate election and pressed for a probe into the hiring of aides by some senators.

data.title: Ministry to look into fake medical records
data.description: More than 80 people have reported suspected misuse of their health records after finding medical histories and medicine claims they said they never received through the Mor Prom application.

data.title: Thamanat insists no 'Monaco deal'
data.description: Capt Thamanat Prompow has rejected claims of a "Monaco deal", insisting his trip to the principality was a family holiday and not linked to political negotiations.

data.title: Two men arrested in hunt for young Russian siblings
data.description: Police have arrested two Thai men while expanding the search for two missing Russian siblings in the Pattaya area, using sniffer dogs to look for clues.
